About Our Brand:

Established in 1992, AIKE has emerged as a global frontrunner in the realm of electric hygiene appliances, spearheading the promotion of meticulous hand hygiene practices worldwide. Anchored by our fundamental ethos of "Creating a Cleaner Life," we are committed to empowering individuals to embrace a healthier, more pristine, and effortlessly convenient lifestyle.

Our Product Portfolio:

At present, our offerings encompass an array of cutting-edge products, including automatic soap dispensers, automatic shampoo dispensers, wall-mounted hand dryers, dual-sided hand dryers, and air taps. While primarily tailored for commercial utilization, a subset of these solutions seamlessly caters to both domestic and commercial environments.

Highlights of Compact Hand Dryers:

  • Elegantly compact design coupled with rapid, robust airflow
  • A mere 7 to 15 seconds for thorough hand drying
  • Remarkable energy efficiency and cost-effectiveness vis-à-vis alternative drying methods
  • User-friendly installation, conducive to hard-wired setups
  • Resilient performance, even in high-traffic restroom facilities
  • Diverse palette of colors harmonizing with various commercial aesthetics

Key Features of Vertical Hand Dryers:

  • Streamlined, slender design promoting graceful hand drying
  • Swift hand drying in a span of 7 to 15 seconds
  • Dual-stage HEPA filtration, effectually eradicating harmful pathogens
  • Engineered to meet the demands of bustling commercial lavatories
  • Straightforward installation, accommodating hard-wired configurations
  • Substantial energy savings, exceeding comparable drying alternatives

Advantages of Automatic Soap Dispensers:

  • Touchless operation to safeguard against germ transmission
  • Precision and alacrity in dispensing soap
  • Compatibility with a wide spectrum of liquid soap variants
  • Ample capacity to service high-traffic, busy restrooms
  • Contemporary, sleek aesthetics harmonizing with diverse commercial settings
  • Effortless installation, facilitated by battery power

For In-depth Product Information:

We invite you to explore our comprehensive range on our official website: www.aike.com

Regarding Payment Procedures:

Our commission-based compensation will be transferred via PayPal within 30 days of the customer's receipt of the order.

Supplementary Information:

  • Our product range is competitively priced, spanning from $20 to $500.
  • Clients frequently opt for bulk purchases for commercial ventures.
  • AIKE boasts a repertoire of 9+ advanced certifications within this industry.
  • Our products have made their mark across 300+ countries and territories.

AIKE Affiliate Terms & Conditions Updated 5/05/2023
